_comment: Hand-maintained corrections applied on top of the NASA ADS query.
The ADS name search 'Solmaz, Arif' also matches other researchers with the
same surname (nuclear physics, condensed matter, chemistry). Once the ADS
refresh runs with an ORCID query these exclusions become redundant, but they
stay here as a safety net. Add a bibcode to exclude_bibcodes to drop a record;
add one to include_notes only to leave yourself a reminder.
exclude_reason: Different researcher(s) named Solmaz — not this author.
confirmed_note: Community/decadal white papers with large author lists, confirmed by the author as genuine co-authorships (2026-08). Kept on the page; listed here so a future maintainer does not mistake them for name collisions.
